I am a poor man with no schooling, and this small plot of sorghum is intercropped to feed my family. Sorghum does not get the FISP coupons like maize, so I cannot afford to buy fertilizer for it — I will save any little manure from my goats for this plot instead. I will plant the seed I saved from last year, and my wife and I will weed by hand. I cannot pay for workers; we will do the work ourselves.
